primary.comment: Primary brand color and the fill of primary actions. The focus and glow shadows are tinted with it; the theme overrides repaint it per palette.

accent.comment: Interactive accent for selected, active and focus states (a checked checkbox, an active chip, a selected card). The same in both theme palettes.

accentRgb.comment: The accent as an r, g, b triple for translucent tints: rgba(var(--color-brand-accent-rgb), 0.12). Rebind it together with the accent.

accentSoft.comment: Translucent accent fill behind an active or selected control.

accentSoftStrong.comment: Translucent accent border paired with the soft fill.

accentDeep.comment: Deep purple. Distinct from primary; used as a gradient stop and rarely on its own.

highlight.comment: Hot pink highlight. The first stop of the brand gradient; use sparingly on its own.

slate.comment: Muted blue-grey for low-emphasis informational fills (toast progress drains, hover halos, info notification tints).

gradient.comment: Brand gradient. The one 4-stop definition every gradient surface uses, so marketing and product surfaces match.

primary.comment: Slightly off-white to reduce eye strain on dark surfaces.

strongHover.comment: Solid dark-mode hover border. Use when hover should be a solid color instead of a translucent overlay.

success.comment: Running and healthy status green for status dots, badges and success icons. Softer than Tailwind green-500 so it does not glare on dark surfaces.

danger.comment: Semantic error red for destructive actions and failure states.
